passed_evidence: Dealer weekly net-position change was independent enough from the closed Leveraged Money and Asset Manager deltas in both frozen windows.
Both windows had broad support across signs, chronological quartiles and months, so the rejection is not caused by a sparse sample or one-event concentration.
The deterministic replication was byte-identical and the economic ledger remained unopened after the pre-economic failure.
material_failure: Design directional evidence was not significant at the preregistered one-sided 0.10 level despite a positive median signed response.
Validation median signed response reversed to -0.382281 percent and only 40 of 93 non-overlapping weekly episodes had the expected sign.
Validation negative Dealer changes were followed by a positive 2.101878 percent median BTC return rather than the preregistered negative response.
material_learning: Dealer positioning change is distinct from the already closed CFTC participant factors, but distinctness is not predictive validity. The preregistered continuation relation weakened from an insignificant Design tendency to an adverse Validation relation, so opening PnL would only invite outcome-driven rescue.
